verdict.rationale: Otter documents an official MCP Server connecting Claude/ChatGPT to meeting transcripts, action items, and cross-meeting search, with OAuth authentication and granular, explicitly-authorized permissions — matching the story's core requirements. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server working (only vendor blog/docs cited) and no detail on setup friction or 'no glue code' claim beyond marketing copy.
